caseNameFull: Eugene M. Thayer, in Error v. Eliza M. Schaben
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Kansas.
attorneys: Mr. Charles H. Pegler, Mr. Arthur J. Eddy and Mr. Emil C. Wetten for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Fred S. Jackson for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam. Mr. Charles H. Pegler, Mr. Arthur J. Eddy and Mr. Emil C. Wetten for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Fred S. Jackson for the defendants in error.

Writ of error dismissed for want of jurisdiction. California National Bank v. Thomas, 171 U. S. 441; Appleby v. Buffalo, 221 U. S. 524, 529.
